items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة
items.reference: Al-Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmizi, 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 7/47.
items.title: When wearing a garment
items.translation: Praise is to Allah Who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me, though I was powerless myself and incapable

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ, أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ, وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
items.reference: Abu Dawud, At-Tirmizi. Al-Albani, Mukhtasar Shamd'il At-Tirmizi, p. 47.
items.title: When wearing a new garment
items.translation: O Allah, praise is to You. You have clothed me. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what it has been made for, and I seek Your protection from the evil of it and the evil of what it has been made for.

items.reference: Abu Dawud 4/41, Al-Albani Sahih Abu Dawud 2/760.
items.title: To someone wearing a new garment
items.translation: May Allah replace it when it is worn out.

items.arabic: اِلْبَسْ جَدِيداً وَعِشْ حَمِيداً وَمُتْ شَهِيداً
items.reference: Ibn Majah 2/1178, Al-Baghawi 12/41, Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/275
items.title: To someone wearing a new garment
items.translation: Put on new clothes, live a praise-worthy life and die as a martyr.

items.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ) اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث
items.title: Before entering the toilet
items.translation: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, I seek protection in You from the male and female unclean spirits.

items.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmizi, An-Nasa'i, Al-Qayyim's Zadul-Ma'ad, 2/387.
items.title: After leaving the toilet

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ, تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ, وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
items.reference: Abu Dawud 4/325, At-Tirmizi 5/490, Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmizi 3/151
items.title: Upon leaving the home
items.translation: In the Name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, there is no might and no power except by Allah.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ, أَوْ أُضَلَّ, أَوْ أَزِلَّ, أَوْ أُزَلَّ, أَوْ أَظْلِمَ, أَوْ أُظْلَمَ, أَوْ أَجْهَلَ, أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmizi, Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmizi 3/152, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/336
items.title: Upon leaving the home
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I misguide others, or I am misguided by others, lest I cause others to err or I am caused to err, lest I abuse others or be abused, and lest I behave foolishly or meet with the foolishness of others.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا, وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا, وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا, ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ
items.title: When entering the home
items.translation: In the Name of Allah we enter, in the Name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.(One should mention the Name of Allah when entering the home and when beginning to eat; and that the devil, hearing this, says: “there is no shelter for us here tonight and no food”.)

items.title: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast

items.title: For expelling the devil and his whisperings
For expelling the devil and his whisperings
items.translation: Recitation of the authentic zikr (remembrance of Allah) and the Qur'an. The Devil is driven out by the invocations for morning and evening, zikr before sleeping and upon waking up, zikr for entering and leaving the house, including those for entering and leaving the mosque, and by many other authentic invocations taught to us by the Prophet (SAW) such as the reading of 'Ayatul-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255), and the last two 'ayat of Surat Al-Baqarah and zikr no. 93 100 times, it will be a protection for him from the Devil throughout the day. Also call to prayer (athan).

items.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ, وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ, وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
items.title: To the newlywed
items.translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ, اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ, وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
items.title: Before sexual intercourse
items.translation: With the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Devil away from us and keep the Devil away from that which You provide for us.

items.arabic: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ, أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ, أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ
items.title: When in fear of afflicting something or someone with one’s eye
items.translation: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property (then ask Allah to bless him in it) for the envious eye is real.

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ, وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ, وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ, وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا, وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ, وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا, وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ, وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
items.title: To ward off the deception of the obstinate devils
items.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah - which neither the upright nor the corrupt may overcome - from the evil of what He created, of what He made, and of what He scattered, from the evil of what descends from the heavens, and of what rises up to them, from the evil of what He scattered in the earth and of what emerges from it, from the evil trials of night and day, and from the evil of every night visitor, except the night visitor who comes with good. O Merciful One.

items.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَكُفُّوا صِبْيانَكُم, فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ, فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ, وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً, وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ, وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ, وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم, وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ, وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً, وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ
items.title: General and beneficent rules
items.translation: When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour (the first hour) of the night, (you may) let them (the children) go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps.
